title: Repair Estimates & Appointments — Bookings a Customer May Hold
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold any number of Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate bookings at once, across different vehicles; there is no customer-level cap.

The limit on open bookings for one vehicle and the restriction that follows a customer's no-shows are separate rules of Repair Estimates & Appointments; neither is a cap on the number of bookings a customer holds.

**Basis Q&A**

- *A fleet manager has three vehicles damaged at once. May each vehicle be booked?* Yes as far as this rule goes: the bookings are on different vehicles, and the customer has no cap on the number of bookings held.
- *Does holding several bookings already count against a new one?* Not under this rule; a customer-level count of bookings is never applied.
